{{translated title}} [[File:Team Rocket Expedition.png|thumb|250px|Japanese logo]] '''Team Rocket Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth''' (Japanese: '''愛と真実の悪を貫くロケット探検団''' ''Rocket Gang Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth'') is a series of short stories that occurs at the end of episodes in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. The segments are shown exclusively in the Japanese version, placed after the [[List of Japanese ending themes|ending theme]] of the episode. Introduced in [[JN133]] and ended in [[JN138]], each segment contains a part where the [[Team Rocket trio]] travels through the [[Paldea]] [[region]], looking for Pokémon from said region for them to {{pkmn2|Caught|catch}}. The segment always ends with the Pokémon attacking the Team Rocket trio directly or indirectly. ==List of segments== {{Episodelistheader|SV}} {{Episodelistbody|JN133|None|第1話|{{DL||Episode 1}}|None|November 25, 2022|Sprigatito TRE.png}} {{Episodelistbody|JN134|None|第2話|{{DL||Episode 2}}|None|December 2, 2022|Fuecoco TRE.png}} {{Episodelistbody|JN135|None|第3話|{{DL||Episode 3}}|None|December 9, 2022|Quaxly TRE.png}} {{Episodelistbody|JN137|None|第4話|{{DL||Episode 4}}|None|January 13, 2023|Koraidon TRE.png}} {{Episodelistbody|JN138|None|第5話|{{DL||Episode 5}}|None|January 20, 2023|Miraidon TRE.png}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|SV|This concludes Team Rocket Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth.}} ==Episode 1== ===Summary=== In search of a new Pokémon, the Team Rocket trio has visited the [[Paldea]] [[region]] for the first time. They encounter a wild {{p|Sprigatito}} and try to catch it, but Sprigatito releases a scent, which makes them feel sleepy, and runs away, much to their dismay. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] * {{an|Giovanni}} (fantasy) ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Persian}} ({{OP|Giovanni|Persian}}; fantasy) * {{p|Sprigatito}} (debut) ==Episode 2== ===Summary=== Continuing their quest, the trio finds a {{p|Fuecoco}}. As they attempt to capture it, [[Jessie]] accidentally pulls out an [[Oran Berry]] instead of a {{i|Poké Ball}}, prompting Fuecoco to charge at the Berry and blast Team Rocket off with a fire attack. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Fuecoco}} (debut) ==Episode 3== ===Summary=== Continuing their quest, the trio comes across a {{p|Quaxly}}. Jessie, James, and Meowth each attempt to catch it by throwing a Poké Ball, but Quaxly furiously blasts them all off with {{m|Water Gun}} and escapes safely. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Quaxly}} (debut) ==Episode 4== ===Summary=== Continuing their quest, the trio comes across a {{p|Koraidon}}. They prepare to catch it, but Koraidon notices them and proceeds to blast the trio off after chasing them down. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Koraidon}} (debut) * {{p|Grafaiai}} (image) ==Episode 5== ===Summary=== Continuing their quest, the trio comes across a {{p|Miraidon}}. They prepare to catch it, but Miraidon notices them, zooming past the trio before blasting them off with an {{t|Electric}} attack. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Miraidon}} (debut) * {{p|Koraidon}} (image) * {{p|Grafaiai}} (image) ==Trivia== * With {{aniseries|HZ}} featuring a new set of main characters, these segments are the only instances of {{aniseries|PTS}} main characters interacting with Pokémon introduced after [[Generation VIII]], namely [[Generation IX]] Pokémon. ==Related articles== {{Anime bonus segments}}
